chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
lively accordion-like pulse-wave lead with quick grace-note runs
busy bell-buoy chimes and bright sparkle on phrase ends
tambourine and brushed snare on the waltz offbeats, a soft bass drum on each downbeat only
seaside festival dance, celebratory, playful and a little cheeky
seamless transition back to the theme
